question.prompt: Tangents \(PA\) and \(PB\) are drawn from a point \(P\) outside a circle. If \(PA=6\), how long is \(PB\)?

solutions.explanation: Tangent length theorem: The lengths of the 2 tangent segments drawn to a circle from an external point are equal, so \(PB=PA=6\).
solutions.title: Equal tangent lengths
